about: What Seldon assumes about Omarchy (WP-194): installed files under $OMARCHY_PATH, each hashed read-only, each assumption naming the plugin line that relies on it. scripts/check-omarchy-assumptions.sh (`just check-upstream`) compares the hashes; on a mismatch, re-measure the assumption and update sha256, omarchyVersion, measured and the sentence in the same commit, never silence it. docs/TESTING.md, "Omarchy assumptions".

assumptions.relies: Seldon relies on the scoped facade's updateEntryInline(id, settings) replacing the plugin's own shell.json entry and returning true only when something changed, at plugin/Desk.qml:527.
assumptions.remeasure: the desk's settings writes (tests/plugin/desk-view.sh, settings scenarios) and one width change on the test host, read back from the shell.json entry

assumptions.relies: Seldon relies on the facade's serviceFor(own id) handing the bar widget the plugin's own Service.qml instance, at plugin/BarWidget.qml:55.
assumptions.remeasure: the pill finds its service (tests/plugin/bar-view.sh) and shows counts on the test host after a shell restart

assumptions.relies: Seldon relies on the facade's summon, hide and toggle taking the plugin's own id and returning true when they act, at plugin/BarWidget.qml:75.
assumptions.remeasure: a left click on the pill and `omarchy-shell jax.seldon.panel toggle` open and close the desk on the test host

assumptions.relies: Seldon relies on a manifest with `overlay` and `bar-widget` being owned by the panel loader, so `shell summon|hide|toggle jax.seldon` reaches Desk.qml and hide() unloads it, at plugin/Desk.qml:175.
assumptions.remeasure: `omarchy-shell shell toggle jax.seldon` and `shell call jax.seldon view ""` on the test host (SPEC-PLUGIN §8)

assumptions.relies: Seldon relies on the overlay loader assigning shell, manifest and service (the plugin's own Service.qml) after the desk is created, each starting as null, at plugin/Desk.qml:66.
assumptions.remeasure: the desk opens with its service bound (tests/plugin/desk-view.sh creates it bare and assigns in the shell's order) and `view` on the test host

assumptions.relies: Seldon relies on the shell's plugin reload clearing the component cache only when Qt offers it, so new plugin code needs a shell restart and the update notice offers one, at plugin/Model.js:4092.
assumptions.remeasure: after `omarchy plugin update` on the test host: the desk shows the restart notice and new code runs only after a restart (memory/omarchy-shell.md, WP-090)

assumptions.relies: Seldon relies on the shell handing the service a fresh copy of manifest.json after every rescan, whose version the service compares with the code's own, at plugin/Service.qml:75.
assumptions.remeasure: tests/plugin/service-states.sh (update notice) and an `omarchy plugin update` on the test host

assumptions.relies: Seldon relies on the third-party bar facade offering moduleWidgets(id) and a scoped shell, so one pill instance owns the `jax.seldon.panel` IPC target, at plugin/BarWidget.qml:138.
assumptions.remeasure: tests/plugin/bar-view.sh and tests/plugin/ipc-restart.sh, and no "another handler is registered" line in the test host's shell log

assumptions.relies: Seldon relies on the bar building the widget once per monitor plus a zero-size, hidden placeholder in the centre section, all listed by moduleWidgets, at plugin/Model.js:4127.
assumptions.remeasure: tests/plugin/bar-view.sh, and on the test host `omarchy-shell jax.seldon.panel pill` answers once with one handler

assumptions.relies: Seldon relies on the shell's pickDrawnSlot choosing the first visible, non-zero-size slot, which Model.pickDrawnWidget mirrors, at plugin/Model.js:4136.
assumptions.remeasure: the shell's pickDrawnSlot and isDrawnSlot against Model.pickDrawnWidget and isDrawnWidget (node tests/plugin/model.test.js), then tests/plugin/bar-view.sh

assumptions.relies: Seldon relies on the BarWidget base exposing the inline shell.json entry as settings and setting(name, fallback), at plugin/BarWidget.qml:46.
assumptions.remeasure: `omarchy bar set jax.seldon captureIntervalMin 30 --json` on the test host reaches the service (`omarchy-shell jax.seldon.service status`)

assumptions.relies: Seldon relies on the Style tokens, among them Style.bar.iconCanvas (16 px at scale 1.0) sizing the pill's glyph box, at plugin/BarWidget.qml:249.
assumptions.remeasure: `just qmllint` (the token check against Commons) and the pill's glyph at scale 1.0 and 1.25 (tests/plugin/bar-view.sh)

assumptions.relies: Seldon relies on the Color tokens following the active theme, among them Color.popups.text as the desk's foreground, at plugin/Desk.qml:135.
assumptions.remeasure: `just qmllint` (the token check) and the desk in two themes, one light (docs/TESTING.md, theme renders)

assumptions.relies: Seldon relies on Border.surfaceSpec(section, token, colour, width) giving the desk card the theme's popup border, at plugin/Desk.qml:706.
assumptions.remeasure: the desk card's border in tests/plugin/desk-view.sh renders and in two themes on the test host

assumptions.relies: Seldon relies on the qs.Ui BorderSurface drawing the desk card with its colour and borderSpec, at plugin/Desk.qml:697.
assumptions.remeasure: tests/plugin/desk-view.sh renders and the desk card on the test host

assumptions.relies: Seldon relies on qs.Ui Button with focusable: true being a Tab stop that Enter and Space click, and on its label never eliding, at plugin/components/desk/NewCaseSheet.qml:276.
assumptions.remeasure: the desk's key paths (tests/plugin/desk-view.sh, Tab and Enter scenarios) and the label-fit probe

assumptions.relies: Seldon relies on qs.Ui ButtonGroup emitting changed(value) without assigning value itself, so a binding on value survives, at plugin/components/desk/NewCaseSheet.qml:179.
assumptions.remeasure: the new-case sheet's chips (tests/plugin/desk-view.sh) and a reset after submit

assumptions.relies: Seldon relies on qs.Ui Dropdown exposing popupOpen and taking focus on an inner trigger, so the field counts as editing while its popup is open, at plugin/components/desk/JournalField.qml:35.
assumptions.remeasure: the journal field's keys (tests/plugin/desk-view.sh: Tab to the trigger, Down opens, Enter picks) with the desk's key catcher blocked meanwhile

assumptions.relies: Seldon relies on `omarchy plugin update` pulling the git checkout and rescanning plugins without restarting the shell, which is why the update notice exists, at plugin/Model.js:4093.
assumptions.remeasure: `omarchy plugin update jax.seldon` on the test host with a newer checkout: the notice appears, nothing restarts by itself

assumptions.relies: Seldon relies on omarchy-restart-shell, run without arguments from a detached process, restarting the shell and refusing while a secure lock is up, at plugin/Model.js:4097.
assumptions.remeasure: the notice's Restart shell on the test host gives one new shell within seconds (memory/omarchy-shell.md, WP-090)

assumptions.relies: Seldon relies on Omarchy's validator accepting the manifest's schemaVersion 1, kinds, entry points and the unknown `seldon` key, and CI runs the same file through packaging/omarchy-pin, at plugin/manifest.json:2.
assumptions.remeasure: `omarchy plugin validate plugin/`, then refresh packaging/omarchy-pin to the new validator (packaging/README.md, "The Omarchy pin")

assumptions.relies: Seldon relies on the shell README's plugin contract (manifest keys, entry points per kind, the injected properties), at plugin/manifest.json:10.
assumptions.remeasure: read the README's diff against SPEC-PLUGIN §1, §8 and memory/omarchy-shell.md
